name: @meridian/ai
description: AI gateway (ROADMAP Phase 8, ARCHITECTURE §8). Vendor-neutral AiProvider abstraction + AiSession pipeline (cache/replay → budget → provider → zod validate → one repair → typed rejection). First-class AnthropicProvider and OpenAiProvider adapters; MockProvider for offline tests. Vendor SDK imports are confined to src/providers/*-client.ts (§20). Keys enter only from env/config edges, never graph documents.
